local function L(key)

-- ===== ДАННЫЕ =====
points = {}
pointId = 0
speed = 25
instant = false
uiSize = 0.85
isMinimized = false
activeTab = 1

-- Цвета интерфейса
uiColorIndex = 1
isUIRainbow = false
uiRainbowTask = nil
uiColors = {
    Color3.fromRGB(25, 25, 45),
    Color3.fromRGB(100, 40, 150),
    Color3.fromRGB(220, 40, 40),
    Color3.fromRGB(40, 100, 220),
    Color3.fromRGB(40, 220, 40),
    Color3.fromRGB(255, 150, 20),
    Color3.fromRGB(255, 50, 180),
    Color3.fromRGB(20, 220, 220),
}
currentColor = uiColors[1]

-- Просветка
highlightColorIndex = 1
isRainbow = false
highlightActive = false
highlightObjects = {}
highlightTask = nil
highlightConnections = {}
highlightColors = {
    {Color3.fromRGB(0, 255, 255), "🩵"},
    {Color3.fromRGB(255, 0, 0), "🔴"},
    {Color3.fromRGB(0, 255, 0), "🟢"},
    {Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 0), "🟡"},
    {Color3.fromRGB(255, 0, 255), "🟣"},
    {Color3.fromRGB(255, 165, 0), "🟠"},
    {Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255), "⚪"},
    {Color3.fromRGB(0, 150, 255), "🔵"},
    {nil, "🌈"},
}
currentHighlightColor = highlightColors[1][1]

-- Автокрикер
autoCrikerEnabled = false
autoCrikerThreshold = 10
autoCrikerDelay = 5
autoCrikerTarget = nil
autoCrikerTask = nil
autoCrikerRunning = false

-- Слоты
slots = {}
for i = 1, 10 do slots[i] = {points = {}, pointId = 0} end

-- ==========================================================
--  ФУНКЦИЯ КОПИРОВАНИЯ
-- ==========================================================
local function copyToClipboard(text)
    local success = false
    if setclipboard then pcall(function() setclipboard(text) end) success = true
    elseif toclipboard then pcall(function() toclipboard(text) end) success = true
    elseif clipboard then pcall(function() clipboard(text) end) success = true
    elseif game:GetService("GuiService") and game:GetService("GuiService").SetClipboard then
        pcall(function() game:GetService("GuiService"):SetClipboard(text) end) success = true
    end
    return success
end

local function copyCoordinates(pos)
    local str = string.format("X: %.2f, Y: %.2f, Z: %.2f", pos.X, pos.Y, pos.Z)
    local ok = copyToClipboard(str)
    if ok then
        print(L("coordinatesCopied") .. str)
        local notif = Instance.new("TextLabel")
        notif.Size = UDim2.new(0, 300, 0, 40)
        notif.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, -150, 0.3, 0)
        notif.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(0, 200, 0)
        notif.BackgroundTransparency = 0.2
        notif.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
        notif.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
        notif.TextSize = 18
        notif.Text = L("copyCoordinates")
        notif.Parent = gui
        game:GetService("Debris"):AddItem(notif, 1.5)
    else
        print(L("copyError") .. str)
    end
end

-- ==========================================================
--  АНИМАЦИЯ ТЕЛЕПОРТА
-- ==========================================================
function playTeleportAnimation()
    local char = player.Character
    if not char then return nil, 0 end

    local humanoid = char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
    if not humanoid then return nil, 0 end

    local animator = humanoid:FindFirstChildOfClass("Animator")
    if not animator then
        animator = Instance.new("Animator")
        animator.Parent = humanoid
    end

    local animation = Instance.new("Animation")
    animation.AnimationId = TELEPORT_ANIMATION_ID

    local track
    local ok = pcall(function()
        track = animator:LoadAnimation(animation)
    end)

    if not ok or not track then
        return nil, 0
    end

    track.Priority = Enum.AnimationPriority.Action
    track:Play(0.1)

    return track, track.Length
end

-- ==========================================================
--  ФУНКЦИИ ТЕЛЕПОРТА
-- ==========================================================

function teleportToPosition(pos)
    local char = player.Character
    if not char then return end
    local hrp = char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
    if not hrp then return end

    -- Запускаем анимацию телепорта
    local animTrack, animDuration = playTeleportAnimation()

    if instant then
        -- Короткая задержка для начала анимации
        task.wait(0.15)
        hrp.CFrame = CFrame.new(pos)
        if animTrack then
            local waitTime = math.max(0, animDuration - 0.15)
            if waitTime > 0 then task.wait(waitTime) end
            pcall(function() animTrack:Stop(0.2) end)
        end
        print(L("instantTp"))
        return
    end

    local hum = char:FindFirstChild("Humanoid")
    if hum then
        hum.PlatformStand = true
        hum.AutoRotate = false
    end
    local dist = (hrp.Position - pos).Magnitude
    local dur = math.max(dist / speed, 0.1)
    pcall(function()
        local tween = game:GetService("TweenService"):Create(
            hrp,
            TweenInfo.new(dur, Enum.EasingStyle.Linear),
            {CFrame = CFrame.new(pos)}
        )
        local bv = Instance.new("BodyVelocity")
        bv.MaxForce = Vector3.new(1/0, 1/0, 1/0)
        bv.Velocity = Vector3.new(0, 0, 0)
        bv.Parent = hrp
        tween:Play()
        tween.Completed:Wait()
        bv:Destroy()
    end)
    if hum then
        hum.PlatformStand = false
        hum.AutoRotate = true
    end

    -- Дожидаемся окончания анимации
    if animTrack then
        local remaining = math.max(0, animDuration - dur - 0.15)
        if remaining > 0 then task.wait(remaining) end
        pcall(function() animTrack:Stop(0.2) end)
    end

    print(L("smoothTp"))
end

function savePoint()
    local char = player.Character
    if not char then return end
    local hrp = char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
    if not hrp then return end
    pointId = pointId + 1
    points[L("pointPrefix") .. pointId] = hrp.Position
    refreshAllLists()
    print(L("pointSaved") .. pointId)
end

function clearPoints()
    points = {}
    pointId = 0
    refreshAllLists()
    print(L("pointsCleared"))
end

function teleportToPlayer(targetPlayer)
    if not targetPlayer then return end
    local char = targetPlayer.Character
    if not char then return end
    local hrp = char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
    if hrp then teleportToPosition(hrp.Position) end
end

-- Просветка
function stopHighlight()
    if highlightTask then pcall(coroutine.close, highlightTask) highlightTask = nil end
    for _, conn in ipairs(highlightConnections) do if conn then conn:Disconnect() end end
    highlightConnections = {}
    for _, h in ipairs(highlightObjects) do if h and h.Parent then h:Destroy() end end
    highlightObjects = {}
    highlightActive = false
    print(L("highlightOff"))
end

function startHighlight()
    if highlightActive then stopHighlight() return end
    highlightActive = true
    highlightObjects = {}
    local function createHighlight(char)
        if not char then return end
        for _, h in ipairs(highlightObjects) do if h.Parent == char then return end end
        local h = Instance.new("Highlight")
        h.Parent = char
        h.FillTransparency = 0.4
        h.OutlineColor = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
        h.OutlineTransparency = 0
        table.insert(highlightObjects, h)
        return h
    end
    local function updateAllHighlights(color)
        for _, h in ipairs(highlightObjects) do if h and h.Parent then h.FillColor = color end end
    end
    local function onPlayerAdded(p)
        local conn = p.CharacterAdded:Connect(function(char)
            task.wait(0.5)
            if highlightActive then
                local h = createHighlight(char)
                if not isRainbow and h then h.FillColor = currentHighlightColor end
            end
        end)
        table.insert(highlightConnections, conn)
        if p.Character then
            task.wait(0.5)
            if highlightActive then
                local h = createHighlight(p.Character)
                if not isRainbow and h then h.FillColor = currentHighlightColor end
            end
        end
    end
    local playerAddedConn = game:GetService("Players").PlayerAdded:Connect(onPlayerAdded)
    table.insert(highlightConnections, playerAddedConn)
    for _, p in ipairs(game:GetService("Players"):GetPlayers()) do
        if p ~= player and p.Character then createHighlight(p.Character) end
    end
    if isRainbow then
        local hue = 0
        highlightTask = coroutine.create(function()
            while highlightActive do
                hue = (hue + 0.015) % 1
                updateAllHighlights(Color3.fromHSV(hue, 1, 1))
                task.wait(0.05)
            end
        end)
        coroutine.resume(highlightTask)
        print(L("rainbowOn"))
    else
        updateAllHighlights(currentHighlightColor)
        print(L("highlightOn") .. highlightColors[highlightColorIndex][2])
    end
end

function toggleHighlight()
    if highlightActive then stopHighlight() else startHighlight() end
end

-- Радужный фон
function startUIRainbow()
    if isUIRainbow then return end
    isUIRainbow = true
    local hue = 0
    uiRainbowTask = coroutine.create(function()
        while isUIRainbow do
            hue = (hue + 0.008) % 1
            if main then main.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromHSV(hue, 1, 1) end
            task.wait(0.05)
        end
    end)
    coroutine.resume(uiRainbowTask)
end

function stopUIRainbow()
    isUIRainbow = false
    if uiRainbowTask then coroutine.close(uiRainbowTask) uiRainbowTask = nil end
    if main then
        if uiColorIndex <= #uiColors then
            main.BackgroundColor3 = uiColors[uiColorIndex]
        else
            main.BackgroundColor3 = uiColors[1]
        end
    end
end

-- ==========================================================
--  АВТОКРИКЕР
-- ==========================================================
function startAutoCriker()
    if autoCrikerRunning then return end
    if not autoCrikerTarget then
        print(L("autoCrikerNoTarget"))
        return
    end
    autoCrikerEnabled = true
    autoCrikerRunning = true
    autoCrikerTask = coroutine.create(function()
        while autoCrikerEnabled do
            local players = game:GetService("Players"):GetPlayers()
            local count = #players
            if count >= autoCrikerThreshold then
                print(L("autoCrikerTeleport") .. count .. L("autoCrikerTeleport2") .. autoCrikerThreshold .. L("autoCrikerTeleport3"))
                teleportToPosition(autoCrikerTarget)
            end
            task.wait(autoCrikerDelay)
        end
        autoCrikerRunning = false
    end)
    coroutine.resume(autoCrikerTask)
    print(L("autoCrikerEnabled") .. autoCrikerThreshold .. ", " .. L("delay") .. " " .. autoCrikerDelay .. L("seconds") .. ")")
    updateAutoUI()
end

function stopAutoCriker()
    autoCrikerEnabled = false
    if autoCrikerTask then
        coroutine.close(autoCrikerTask)
        autoCrikerTask = nil
    end
    autoCrikerRunning = false
    print(L("autoCrikerDisabled"))
    updateAutoUI()
end

function toggleAutoCriker()
    if autoCrikerEnabled then
        stopAutoCriker()
    else
        startAutoCriker()
    end
end

function selectAutoTarget()
    local pointNames = {}
    for name, _ in pairs(points) do table.insert(pointNames, name) end
    if #pointNames == 0 then
        print(L("noPoints"))
        return
    end
    local popup = Instance.new("Frame")
    popup.Size = UDim2.new(0, 300 * uiSize, 0, 300 * uiSize)
    popup.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, -150 * uiSize, 0.5, -150 * uiSize)
    popup.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(20, 20, 40)
    popup.BackgroundTransparency = 0.1
    popup.Active = true
    popup.Draggable = true
    popup.Parent = gui

    local corner = Instance.new("UICorner")
    corner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 10)
    corner.Parent = popup

    local popupTitle = Instance.new("TextLabel")
    popupTitle.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 35 * uiSize)
    popupTitle.BackgroundTransparency = 1
    popupTitle.Text = L("selectTarget")
    popupTitle.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
    popupTitle.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
    popupTitle.TextSize = 18 * uiSize
    popupTitle.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Center
    popupTitle.Parent = popup

    local scroll = Instance.new("ScrollingFrame")
    scroll.Size = UDim2.new(1, -10, 0, 220 * uiSize)
    scroll.Position = UDim2.new(0, 5, 0, 40 * uiSize)
    scroll.BackgroundTransparency = 1
    scroll.CanvasSize = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, 0)
    scroll.ScrollBarThickness = 4
    scroll.Parent = popup

    local y = 0
    for _, name in ipairs(pointNames) do
        local btn = Instance.new("TextButton")
        btn.Size = UDim2.new(1, -8, 0, 32 * uiSize)
        btn.Position = UDim2.new(0, 4, 0, y)
        btn.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(45, 45, 65)
        btn.BorderSizePixel = 0
        btn.Text = name
        btn.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
        btn.Font = Enum.Font.Gotham
        btn.TextSize = 14 * uiSize
        btn.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
        btn.Parent = scroll
        btn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
            autoCrikerTarget = points[name]
            print(L("targetSelected") .. name)
            popup:Destroy()
            updateAutoUI()
        end)
        y = y + 36 * uiSize
    end
    scroll.CanvasSize = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, y + 10)

    local closeBtn = Instance.new("TextButton")
    closeBtn.Size = UDim2.new(0.4, 0, 0, 35 * uiSize)
    closeBtn.Position = UDim2.new(0.3, 0, 0, 265 * uiSize)
    closeBtn.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(200, 50, 50)
    closeBtn.BorderSizePixel = 0
    closeBtn.Text = L("close")
    closeBtn.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
    closeBtn.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
    closeBtn.TextSize = 14 * uiSize
    closeBtn.Parent = popup
    closeBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function() popup:Destroy() end)
end

function updateAutoUI()
    if autoToggleBtn then
        autoToggleBtn.Text = autoCrikerEnabled and L("autoToggleOff") or L("autoToggleOn")
        autoToggleBtn.BackgroundColor3 = autoCrikerEnabled and Color3.fromRGB(200, 50, 50) or Color3.fromRGB(60, 200, 60)
    end
    if autoThresholdLabel then autoThresholdLabel.Text = L("threshold") .. ": " .. autoCrikerThreshold end
    if autoDelayLabel then autoDelayLabel.Text = L("delay") .. ": " .. autoCrikerDelay .. L("seconds") end
    if autoTargetLabel then
        local targetName = L("notSelected")
        for name, pos in pairs(points) do
            if pos == autoCrikerTarget then targetName = name break end
        end
        autoTargetLabel.Text = L("target") .. ": " .. targetName
    end
    if selectTargetBtn then selectTargetBtn.Text = L("select") end
end

-- Слоты
function saveToSlot(n)
    if not next(points) then print(L("noPoints")) return end
    slots[n] = {points = {}, pointId = pointId}
    for k, v in pairs(points) do slots[n].points[k] = v end
    print(L("slotSaved") .. n .. L("saved"))
    updateSlots()
end

function loadFromSlot(n)
    if not slots[n] or not next(slots[n].points) then print(L("slotEmpty")) return end
    points = {}
    for k, v in pairs(slots[n].points) do points[k] = v end
    pointId = slots[n].pointId or 0
    print(L("slotLoaded") .. n .. L("loaded"))
    refreshAllLists()
    updateSlots()
end

-- ==========================================================
--  СМЕНА ЯЗЫКА
-- ==========================================================
function toggleLanguage()
    currentLang = (currentLang == "ru") and "en" or "ru"
    langBtn.Text = L("langBtn")
    applyLanguage()
end

function applyLanguage()
    title.Text = L("title")
    speedLabel.Text = L("speed") .. ": " .. speed
    speedValue.Text = speed
    modeBtn.Text = instant and L("modeInstant") or L("modeSmooth")
    highlightColorLabel.Text = L("highlightColor") .. ":"
    uiColorLabel.Text = L("uiColor") .. ":"
    autoLabel.Text = L("autoCriker")
    
    for i = 1, 4 do
        tabs[i].Text = L("tabPoints")
        if i == 2 then tabs[i].Text = L("tabPlayers") end
        if i == 3 then tabs[i].Text = L("tabSlots") end
        if i == 4 then tabs[i].Text = L("tabSettings") end
    end
    
    updateAutoUI()
    refreshAllLists()
    if activeTab == 3 then updateSlots() end
end

-- ==========================================================
--  ОБНОВЛЕНИЕ СПИСКОВ
-- ==========================================================
function refreshAllLists()
    print(L("refreshing"))
    
    -- Точки
    for _, child in ipairs(pointsList:GetChildren()) do
        if child:IsA("TextButton") then child:Destroy() end
    end
    local y = 0
    for name, pos in pairs(points) do
        local btn = Instance.new("TextButton")
        btn.Size = UDim2.new(0.7, -8, 0, 34 * uiSize)
        btn.Position = UDim2.new(0, 4, 0, y)
        btn.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(45, 45, 60)
        btn.BorderSizePixel = 0
        btn.Text = name
        btn.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
        btn.Font = Enum.Font.Gotham
        btn.TextSize = 14 * uiSize
        btn.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
        btn.Parent = pointsList
        btn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function() teleportToPosition(pos) end)

        local copyBtn = Instance.new("TextButton")
        copyBtn.Size = UDim2.new(0.25, -4, 0, 34 * uiSize)
        copyBtn.Position = UDim2.new(0.72, 0, 0, y)
        copyBtn.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 170, 0)
        copyBtn.BorderSizePixel = 0
        copyBtn.Text = "📋"
        copyBtn.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(0, 0, 0)
        copyBtn.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
        copyBtn.TextSize = 18 * uiSize

function updateUI()
    if not main then return end

    if isMinimized then
        main.Size = UDim2.new(0, 140 * uiSize, 0, 60 * uiSize)
        main.Position = UDim2.new(0.02, 0, 0.5, -30 * uiSize)
        title.Visible = false
        tabFrame.Visible = false
        pointsList.Visible = false
        playersList.Visible = false
        slotsList.Visible = false
        settingsContainer.Visible = false
        saveBtn.Visible = false
        clearBtn.Visible = false
        highlightBtn.Visible = false
        langBtn.Visible = false
        minimizeBtn.Text = "📂"
        minimizeBtn.Size = UDim2.new(0, 32 * uiSize, 0, 28 * uiSize)
    else
        main.Size = UDim2.new(0, 360 * uiSize, 0, 570 * uiSize)
        main.Position = UDim2.new(0.02, 0, 0.08, 0)
        title.Visible = true
        tabFrame.Visible = true
        langBtn.Visible = true
        for j = 1, 4 do
            containers[j].Visible = (j == activeTab)
            tabs[j].BackgroundColor3 = (j == activeTab) and Color3.fromRGB(60, 130, 255) or Color3.fromRGB(40, 40, 60)
            tabs[j].TextColor3 = (j == activeTab) and Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255) or Color3.fromRGB(200, 200, 200)
        end
        saveBtn.Visible = true
        clearBtn.Visible = true
        highlightBtn.Visible = true
        minimizeBtn.Text = "📁"
        minimizeBtn.Size = UDim2.new(0, 40 * uiSize, 0, 30 * uiSize)

        task.spawn(function()
            task.wait(0.1)
            refreshAllLists()
            if activeTab == 3 then updateSlots() end
        end)
    end

    main.BackgroundColor3 = currentColor

    speedLabel.Text = L("speed") .. ": " .. speed
    speedValue.Text = speed
    modeBtn.Text = instant and L("modeInstant") or L("modeSmooth")
    modeBtn.BackgroundColor3 = instant and Color3.fromRGB(255, 170, 0) or Color3.fromRGB(60, 130, 255)

    if uiColorFrame then
        for i, child in ipairs(uiColorFrame:GetChildren()) do
            if child:IsA("TextButton") then
                if isUIRainbow and i == 9 then
                    child.BorderColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(0, 255, 0)
                else
                    child.BorderColor3 = (i == uiColorIndex and not isUIRainbow) and Color3.fromRGB(0, 255, 0) or Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
                end
            end
        end
    end
    if highlightColorFrame then
        for i, child in ipairs(highlightColorFrame:GetChildren()) do
            if child:IsA("TextButton") then
                child.BorderColor3 = (i == highlightColorIndex) and Color3.fromRGB(0, 255, 0) or Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
            end
        end
    end

    updateAutoUI()
end
